items.definition:
be upright, tolerate
Please stand up.

consume food
I want to eat pizza.

enjoy
I really enjoy reading books.

write
I need to write an email.

start
The movie begins at 7 PM.

fail to remember
Don't forget to lock the door.

to hear with attention
Please listen carefully to the instructions.

to rest in a state of unconsciousness
I need to sleep for at least eight hours.

to say words; to talk
Can you speak louder?

to use money or time
I like to spend time with my family.

to finish
I need to finish my homework.

to have clothes on your body
She likes to wear colorful dresses.

take a seat
Please sit down.

transport, hold
Can you help me carry these bags?

to determine the total number of a collection of items
Can you count to ten.

to exert force on (someone or something) so as to cause movement toward oneself or the thing exerting the force.
Pull the door open.

to exert force on (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself.
Push the button to start.

to make a picture with a pencil or pen
Can you draw a picture of a house?

to come or go into
Please enter the room quietly.

arrive
What time will you arrive?

to impart knowledge
She wants to teach English abroad.

to push oneself off the ground
The cat likes to jump on the table.

make sounds of amusement
She started to laugh at the joke.

cook
I like to cook dinner every evening.

shed tears
The baby started to cry.

to make musical sounds with the voice
She loves to sing in the shower.

to perceive odor
I can smell the fresh bread.

to clean with water and usually soap
Please wash your hands before dinner.

to move through water using your body
I love to swim in the ocean during summer.

take air into and expel it from the lungs
It's important to breathe deeply when you exercise.

the process of becoming dry
The clothes are drying on the line.

to move by turning over and over
The ball started to roll down the hill.

were not
They weren't at the party last night.

past tense of fall; to cut down (a tree)
He fell off his bike and scraped his knee.

telling untruths; resting in a horizontal position
He was caught lying about his age.

received; obtained; became
I got a new phone yesterday.
